footnote_text: On May 27, 2026 (the "Grant Date"), Snail, Inc. (the "Issuer") granted the reporting person 65,360 time-based restricted stock units ("RSUs") under the Issuer's 2022 Omnibus Incentive Plan (the "Plan") for serving as a member of the Issuer's Board of Directors (the "Board") for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. Subsequent to the Grant Date and prior to the filing of this Report, the Company effected a 1-for-5 reverse split of its outstanding common stock (the "Reverse Split"). The number of RSUs reported in Column 4 has been retroactively adjusted to give effect to the Reverse Split. The RSUs vest in four (4) equal quarterly installments over the course of one (1) year, subject to the reporting person's continued service with the Issuer or any subsidiary thereof through the applicable vesting date. || Adjusted to give effect to the Reverse Split.
